result.explanation: Each encode event independently maps its value to a canonical JSON serialization. Objects are recursively key-sorted; arrays retain order; scalars preserve their JSON types and values. State is unchanged and irrelevant.
result.mapping: input event.value -> output.key via canonical JSON serialization; prior state does not affect the mapping.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated JSON, depth, numeric, key, and event constraints. The host executes JavaScript and accepts a synchronous solve function.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;function q(v){if(v===null)return'null';if(typeof v==='string')return'"'+v.replace(/[\\"\u0000-\u001f]/g,function(c){return({'\\':'\\\\','"':'\\"','\b':'\\b','\f':'\\f','\n':'\\n','\r':'\\r','\t':'\\t'})[c]||'\\u'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4,'0')})+'"';if(typeof v==='number'||typeof v==='boolean')return String(v);if(Array.isArray(v))return'['+v.map(q)+']';return'{'+Object.keys(v).sort().map(function(k){return q(k)+':'+q(v[k])}).join(',')+'}'}for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++)if(!input.events[i]||input.events[i].type!=='encode'||!output[i]||output[i].key!==q(input.events[i].value))return false;return true}
